epoch_1.description: First 72 draws before any multi-epoch parameter accumulation
epoch_1.min_draws_detail: Seed 404 drew AF 2 times and WS 2 times; all other classes received >= 3 draws across all seeds.
epoch_1.conclusion: No class is starved in Epoch 1. Every phenomenon class is presented in the first epoch across all seeds.

epochs_1_3_warmup.description: First 216 draws during learning rate warmup (1e-5 to 5e-4)
epochs_1_3_warmup.conclusion: Substantial exposure across all classes during warmup.

epochs_1_7_treatment_peak.description: First 504 draws covering all Treatment peak epochs (Seeds 42, 101, 303 at Ep 5; Seed 202 at Ep 6; Seed 404 at Ep 7)

parent_cluster_coverage.description: Fraction of available parent clusters containing class c drawn in Epochs 1-7

linkage_to_experimental_outcomes.mechanistic_interpretation: In this 5-seed sample (n=5), early exposure to rare classes during Epochs 1–7 exhibits a descriptive association with Treatment best mIoU (r = +0.6302) and a strong negative descriptive association with Control best mIoU (r = -0.9167), yielding a strong positive descriptive association with paired delta (r = +0.8955, p = 0.0399). This represents a sample-level descriptive association only; under strict empirical governance, no causal attribution or unmeasured gradient mechanisms are asserted from this sampler audit alone.

diagnostic_verdict.verdict_title: SAMPLER EXPOSURE NON-ZERO ACROSS SEEDS, BUT SUFFICIENCY UNRESOLVED; IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT IN C22-D & DESCRIPTIVE OUTCOME ASSOCIATION (n=5)
diagnostic_verdict.sampler_starvation_rationale: Complete exposure absence was not observed under Candidate F; whether exposure was quantitatively sufficient, optimally distributed, or temporally appropriate for learning remains unresolved. Every class received at least 2 draws in Epoch 1, >= 7 draws in Epochs 1-3, and >= 21 draws in Epochs 1-7, covering 100% of available parent clusters for all rare classes.
diagnostic_verdict.implementation_defect_rationale: C22-D contained a silent lookup failure for 'labels_present', causing class-presence weighting to collapse from 30% to 0.141% constant, making C22-D 99.86% pure parent-balanced.
diagnostic_verdict.performance_coupling_rationale: Realized schedule variance in rare-class draws exhibits a descriptive association with paired delta (r = +0.8955, n=5). This descriptive association does not establish causal mechanisms or unmeasured gradient dynamics.

forensic_correction_history.reason: Explicit in-place forensic calibration per repository convention established in C22-H (Decision Logic Reclassification). Excised unmeasured gradient dynamics, bounded n=5 correlations to descriptive associations, and calibrated starvation hypothesis to exact unresolved wording.
forensic_correction_history.original_verdict_title: SAMPLER EXPOSURE ADEQUATE BUT IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT DETECTED & CORRELATED WITH OUTCOME VARIANCE
forensic_correction_history.original_mechanistic_interpretation: High exposure to ultra-rare classes in early epochs strongly boosts Treatment (+0.6302) while severely degrading Control (-0.9167) due to large loss-weight gradient destabilization on noisy rare masks. Consequently, the paired delta between Treatment and Control is almost perfectly explained by early ultra-rare class exposure (r = +0.8955).
